verdict.rationale: LocalAI is an LLM inference server, so prefill/decode disaggregation is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence only documents distributed GPU worker nodes and horizontal scaling. That is general distribution, not a capability that splits the prefill and decode phases across separate resources, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can disaggregate prefill and decode phases for optimized large-scale serving
